title: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit
slides: Why did Jensen Huang just walk away from Hugging Face?
The CEO promises to keep fighting for open source AI
Nvidia's exit signals open source's biggest ally is gone
Your favorite open models may lose their hardware champion
Test one open model this week before the gap widens
thread_text:
1. Nvidia just walked away

Jensen Huang pulled Nvidia from Hugging Face's board, and the open source AI world is feeling the aftershock.

2. Open source keeps losing

Hugging Face's CEO says he'll keep fighting for open models, but without Nvidia's hardware backing, that fight just got harder.

3. No more hardware champion

The company that made open models run fast and cheap is gone. Developers are now stuck with fewer options and rising costs.

4. Your models could slow down

Without Nvidia optimizing for open source, your favorite free models may lag behind closed ones in speed and efficiency.

5. Test one model today

Pick one open model you rely on and run a real task before the gap widens. If you haven't done it, start there.
